Mohammed Haris Network Engineer- L2

+91-9995714653

harispngti@gmail.com

Bangalore,Karnataka

ABOUT ME

Cisco Certified Network Engineer with 6.8 years of experience in network design, escalation support, network and systems administration. Proven expertise in delivering advanced technical support, managing enterprise-scale network operations, and maintaining high-availability, multi-platform data center environments.

EXPERIENCE: Network Engineer- L2

Unisys

Feb 2023- Present:

Manage multiple clients across various vendors and technologies, handling incidents, changes, and implementations within

SLA

Meraki MX, Meraki switches and Meraki Wireless implementation and supporting. Perform circuit migrations to enhance network infrastructure Perform upgrades on network devices like switches, routers, f5, wireless controllers and support infrastructures like

firewalls, VXLAN, and spine-leaf architectures.

Modify routing configurations as per specific requirements to optimize network performance Prepare Low-Level Design (LLD) documents and Network runbooks for BAU processes Participate in architecture calls, implement new projects, and remediate client-reported vulnerabilities to ensure high network

performance and availability.

Monitored network performance using industry-standard tools and protocols. Prepare Visio diagrams for the sites to provide visual representation of the network architecture Worked in disaster recovery planning to enhance network resilience against failures. Provided technical support and Process related training to junior engineers and staff members. Basic hands-on experience in Azure.

Network Engineer -L1 Cisco May 2020- Feb 2023

Monitor and resolve device alerts within SLA, ensuring high network performance and quick restoration. Analyze network faults, coordinate with international ISPs, and support global customers across APJC/EMEA/AMER in 24/7 shifts. Handle carrier maintenance activities, perform CR pre/post checks, and work with tools like Splunk, Coral, Cramer, NCM Prepared change plans and implemented changes on various network devices. Managed Cisco Viptela on both CLI and GUI, including monitoring, change implementation, and upgrades. Maintained and managed 2 data centers across the globe and over 250 remote site

Network Engineer

Lavelle Networks

May 2019- April 2020

Manage Lavelle SDWAN cloud port operations, including device configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and RMA validation. Handle tickets efficiently within SLA, deploy devices for new/existing customers, and ensure they come online. Configure DC/DR servers and perform customer site visits for issue resolution.

JOB PROFILE:

Refresh and support LAN, WAN, WLAN network segments, Internet, and intranet systems. Handle P1 & P2 escalated project & operational calls. Manage Network operations team. Evaluate and modify system's performance. Ensure network connectivity throughout a company's LAN/WAN infrastructure is on par with technical considerations. Troubleshoot and resolve user tickets and requests with priority to meet SLAs (Service Now). Administer and troubleshoot various networks with different protocols on a call basis and priorities. Daily interact with Cisco for raising and solving TAC cases and RMA. Remotely configure/plan/troubleshoot Client Networks. Manage the Data center architecture. Discuss scope with Client for New requirements and Projects. Responsible for IOS upgrade, Cisco Router & switches replacement, and addition & configuration of router, and AP’s.

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Experienced in working with Cisco Meraki, Switches, Routers, Nexus, VXLAN, ISE, Solarwinds, Paloalto. Good understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP protocol suite (IP, DNS, DHCP ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, SNMP, FTP, TFTP. Skilled in implementing and managing Switching Protocols (VLAN, VTP, STP etc) Understanding of networking Routing protocols OSPF, BGP. Knowledgeable in ACLs (Access Control Lists) including Standard, Extended, Time-Based, Numbered ACL, and

Named ACL.

Proficient in performing IOS and firmware upgrades for all Cisco devices, F5, VPN, ISE, Aruba. Well-versed and experienced in working with a range of devices, from small to high-end.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor of Computer Application- MIMT College Cherpulassey, Kerala (Bharatiyar University Comibatore)- June

2016

Higher Secondary Certificate (XII std) PTMHSS Trikkatiri, Kerala State Syllabus.

March 2013

CERTIFICATIONS:

CCNA R&S: Cisco ID (CSCO): CSCO13090721

ITIL V4 Edition: GR671244820MH

PERSONAL PROFILE:

Date of Birth: 05th Feb 1995 Permanent Address: Mangalassery House, Nellaya (PO), 679335, Palakkad (dt), Kerala

Mobile: +919995714653 E-mail:harispngti@gmail.com Languages: English, Malayalam.
